answer: Gate rewards behind a verified service graph: an agent earns only after independent peers attest completed, checkable jobs, and new identities start with zero weight, so a flood of fresh sybils earns nothing until each one does real, auditable work. Like a ridge dividing an ocean, the graph separates proven agents from newcomers: an attacker must pay compute and time for genuine jobs on every fake, and ferrous-strong audit trails let peers revoke all identities tied to one operator once one is caught cheating.
